plans.name: Moderato
plans.note: Agent credit values are approximate values based on typical task token consumption and are for reference only. All Kimi membership features share a single credit pool metered by token usage. Kimi Code has separate 5-hour and weekly rate limits, but the page does not state their numeric values.
